// diagnostic

E3404

`{call}` has no deterministic world provider.

What

`{call}` has no deterministic world provider.

Why

`testing.world` controls virtual time, scheduling, and seeded pseudo-randomness; external effects cannot be replayed.

Fix

Move the call outside `testing.world`, or use a world-supported provider.
